title: DomainStyles
description: Colour and icon of every domain and data product that has a style, so a client holding only a domain or data product reference can draw its chip by id.

entityStyle.description: Colour and icon of one domain or data product. The cover image stays on the entity.

id.description: Id of the domain or data product.

style.description: Colour and icon of the domain or data product.

data.description: Styles of the domains and data products that have a colour or an icon. Entities without either are omitted.
